explanation_short: The KNN model achieved the highest performance metrics, including an R2 score of 0.81717 and the lowest Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 0.012810.
explanation_full: The KNN model was identified as the best benchmark model, achieving an R2 score of 0.81717, a Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 0.11318, and a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.07502. When comparing model performance, KNN significantly outperformed other models like RF (R2: 0.775602) and DT (R2: 0.560453). Furthermore, the top correlated features with HPR are VFA (0.7984), Butyrate (0.7827), and Acetate (0.7641), indicating their strong predictive power for the target variable.
